response.rationale: R4 (Melanoma) is the strongest because it captures the progressive growth, multiple papules, and discoloration, aligning with the malignant features. C1 (Melanoma of upper left lip vermilion) is a subset, lacking the papules and discoloration. R1 (Labial Melanotic Macule) is benign and ignores ulceration and papules. R3 (Peutz-Jeghers) is contradicted by absent family history.
